questions.passage: A hospital's flu vaccination programme vaccinated 5,200 staff. The target was 6,000 staff. The previous year, 4,800 staff were vaccinated.
questions.question: What was the percentage increase in vaccinations from last year to this year? (Round to nearest whole number)

questions.passage: A patient requires heparin at 80 units/kg/hr. The patient weighs 70 kg. Heparin is available as 25,000 units in 50 mL (500 units/mL).
questions.question: What is the infusion rate in mL/hr?
questions.explanation: Dose = 70 kg × 80 units/kg/hr = 5,600 units/hr. Concentration = 500 units/mL. Rate = 5,600 ÷ 500 = 11.2 mL/hr.

questions.passage: A blood bank needs to process 250 units of blood per week. Each unit takes 12 minutes to process. The blood bank operates 5 days per week, 8 hours per day.
questions.question: What percentage of the blood bank's operating time is used for processing? (Round to nearest whole number)
questions.explanation: Time needed = 250 × 12 = 3,000 minutes. Time available = 5 × 8 × 60 = 2,400 minutes. Percentage = (3,000 ÷ 2,400) × 100 = 125%.

questions.passage:
The table shows patient readmission rates by department:

| Department | Admissions | Readmissions within 30 days |
|------------|------------|----------------------------|
| Cardiology | 1,200      | 144                        |
| Respiratory | 950       | 114                        |
| Surgery    | 1,800      | 162                        |
| Geriatrics | 600        | 90                         |
questions.question: Which department has the highest readmission rate?
questions.explanation: Cardiology: 144/1200=12%. Respiratory: 114/950=12%. Surgery: 162/1800=9%. Geriatrics: 90/600=15%. Geriatrics is highest at 15%.

questions.passage: A patient requires a dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min. The patient weighs 65 kg. Dopamine is available as 400 mg in 250 mL (1,600 mcg/mL).
questions.question: What is the infusion rate in mL/hr? (Round to one decimal place)
questions.explanation: Dose = 65 kg × 5 mcg/kg/min = 325 mcg/min = 19,500 mcg/hr. Concentration = 1,600 mcg/mL. Rate = 19,500 ÷ 1,600 = 12.1875 ≈ 12.2 mL/hr.
